test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two questions based on the transverse section of human heart are given below. Find the option that gives the correct answers to both the questions.

Q. Why does the part labelled 'A’ have thick walls?

Q. What is the function of the part labelled ‘B' ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/067a730c423631c05b9b81b9a97a65e66efc43a11ef0e2bfac02b570bb56315e.png]

options.text:
A - Because it pumps blood to the left auricle

B - Does not let the blood flow forward

A - Because it pumps blood to different parts of the body

B - Prevents back flow of blood

A - Because it pumps blood to the pulmonary artery

B - Pumps blood to aorta

A - Because it pumps blood to the right auricle

B - Prevents back flow of blood

solution:
The correct answer is '**A-** Because it pumps blood to different parts of the body and B - Prevents back flow of blood '. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **part A** is **left ventricle** and the **part B** is **Aortic Valve.**
 
• Left ventricle:
 
 
• Out of all the compartments, the **left ventricle** has the thickest wall.
 
• The left ventricle is responsible for pumping the blood towards the different parts of the body
 
 
 
• **Aortic valve: **
 
 
• **Enables blood to pass** from the left ventricle to the aorta.
 
• It prevents backflow of blood into the left ventricle.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Left ventricle: 

 
 
• ​One of the heart's four chambers is the **left ventricle**.
 
• The **mitral valve** separates it from the left atrium in the bottom left corner of the heart.
 
• Blood eventually returns to the left atrium as the heart contracts, passes through the mitral valve, and then enters the left ventricle.
 
 
 
• Aortic valve:
 
 
• The aortic valve opens, allowing **blood to flow into the aortic arch **and then the rest of the body.
 
• The thickest chamber of the heart, the left ventricle is **in charge of delivering oxygen-rich blood** to tissues throughout the body.
 
• The right ventricle, in contrast, only pumps blood to the lungs.
